## File: facebookresearch_co3d/examples/example_co3d_challenge_submission.py

Prompts

```
['run a DBIR challenge submission for CO3Dv2 across all tasks and sequence sets', 'create a dataset map for a CO3Dv2 category and subset using JsonIndexDatasetMapProviderV2', 'update a CO3DSubmission with DBIR predictions for a specific category and subset', 'render a point cloud from depth maps and cameras using dbir_utils for new view synthesis', 'submit CO3D challenge results to the EvalAI evaluation server via the CLI interface', 'run the main function to visualize CO3D dataset object point clouds and render flyaround videos', 'create a PointcloudRenderingModel to render point clouds from a CO3D dataset sequence with configurable render size', 'render point cloud images, masks, and depths from a camera using the PointcloudRenderingModel forward method', 'visualize a 3D Plotly scene with cameras and RGBD point clouds from CO3D dataset frames', 'get an RGBD point cloud from camera, image, depth map, and foreground probability data']
```

Usage

```
{'run_dbir_submission': 'run a DBIR challenge submission for CO3Dv2 across all tasks and sequence sets', 'create_dataset_map': 'create a dataset map for a CO3Dv2 category and subset using JsonIndexDatasetMapProviderV2', 'update_submission_predictions': 'update a CO3DSubmission with DBIR predictions for a specific category and subset', 'render_point_cloud': 'render a point cloud from depth maps and cameras using dbir_utils for new view synthesis', 'submit_to_eval_ai': 'submit CO3D challenge results to the EvalAI evaluation server via the CLI interface'}
```
